dashboard.hero_title: Yi Gwaji Da Sauri. Dauki Mataki Cikin Gaggawa. Kwantar Da Hankali.
dashboard.hero_text: JaundiCare na taimaka wa iyaye su gano cutar shawara (jaundice) cikin sauri ga jarirai, fahimtar alamun kashedi, da sanin lokacin da za a sanya ido, sake yin gwaji, ko tafiya asibiti a ranar ba tare da bata lokaci ba.

edu.what_is.title: Mene ne Jaundice (Cutar Shawara)?
edu.what_is.body: Jaundice na faruwa ne lokacin da wani abu da ake kira bilirubin ya yi yawa a cikin jikin jariri. Wannan yana sa idanu, dasashi, fata, tafukan hannu, ko tafukan kafa su bayyana da launin rawaya.
edu.check.title: Yadda za a duba jaririnka
edu.check.2: Daga leben jariri sama domin ka duba dasashinsa.
edu.check.3: Duba tafukan hannayensa da matakan kafafunsa.
edu.check.4: Lura da yadda yake shan nono da farkawarsa sosai.
edu.dark_skin.title: Gano Jaundice ga Jariri mai Launin Fata mai Duhu (Baki)
edu.dark_skin.body: Jaundice na iya kasancewa da wuyar gani a jikin jariri mai bakar fata. Duba idanunsa, dasashinsa, tafukan hannunsa, da tafukan kafafunsa. Kula da yadda yake shan nono, barcinsa, da kuzarinsa.
edu.what_to_do.title: Abubuwan da ya kamata iyaye su yi
edu.what_to_do.1: Ba da nono akai-akai ba tare da fashi ba.
edu.what_to_do.2: Sanya ido kan jaririnka sosai a cikin 'yan kwanaki na farko bayan haihuwa.
edu.what_to_do.3: Yi amfani da wannan tsarin gwajin duk lokacin da kake da shakka.
edu.what_to_do.4: Tafi asibiti a ranar idan ka gano kowane irin alamun tsanani.
edu.what_not_to_do.title: Abubuwan da bai kamata a yi ba
edu.what_not_to_do.1: Kada ka yi biris da rashin shan nono ko yawan barci mai tsanani.
edu.what_not_to_do.2: Kada ka jinkirta tafiya asibiti idan hankalinka bai kwanta da yanayin jariri ba.
edu.what_not_to_do.3: Kada ka dogara ga sanya jariri a ranar gari kawai a matsayin magani.
edu.what_not_to_do.4: Kada ka dauka cewa kowane jaundice ba shi da hadari.
edu.urgent.title: Lokacin da za a nemi taimakon gaggawa maza-maza
edu.urgent.1: Launin rawaya a cikin awoyi 24 na farko bayan haihuwa
edu.urgent.2: Yawan wuyar farkar da jariri daga barci
edu.urgent.3: Rashin shan nono yadda ya kamata
edu.urgent.4: Jiki ya yi laushi sosai (babu karfin jiki)
edu.urgent.5: Fitsari mai duhu ko bayan gida mai fari fat
care.feeding.title: Taimako kan shayarwa
care.feeding.body: Ba da nono akai-akai yana taimaka wa jikin jariri wajen fitar da bilirubin ta hanyar bayan gida da fitsari.
care.feeding.1: Shayar da jariri sau da yawa a rana
care.feeding.2: Duba ko jaririnka yana da matsalar tsotsar nono
care.feeding.3: Nemi taimakon likita idan jariri ya ki shan nono duk da yana a farke
care.mother.title: Abin da uwaye za su iya yi
care.mother.1: Kasance mai lura da jaririnka duk lokacin da kake shayarwa
care.mother.2: Duba idanunsa da dasashinsa a cikin daki mai kyawun haske
care.mother.3: Tambayi ma'aikatan lafiya idan kana da wata fargaba
care.mother.4: Halarci tarukan duba lafiya bayan haihuwa kamar yadda aka tsara
care.maternal.title: Tallafin uwa bayan haihuwa
care.maternal.body: Su ma uwaye suna bukatar kulawa domin jikinsu ya dawo daidai. Manufarmu ita ce mu rage yawan lokacin da ake dauka a asibiti ta hanyar gano matsaloli da wuri da ba da magani da ya dace akan lokaci.
care.nutrition.title: Tsarin abinci ga uwaye
care.nutrition.1: Sha ruwa akai-akai domin jiki ya kasance da ruwa
care.nutrition.2: Yawaita cin abinci mai gina jiki mai cike da bitamin
care.nutrition.3: Kada uwa ta tsallake abinci yayin da take shayar da jariri
care.nutrition.4: Yi barci duk lokacin da jaririnka ke barci, sannan a nemi taimako idan gajiya ta yi yawa
chw.tag: Tallafin lafiyar jariri a cikin al'umma
chw.title: Tsarukan Kulawa na CHW
chw.intro: Tsarin aikin Ma'aikatan Lafiya na Al'umma (CHW) don gwajin jaundice na jarirai, sanya ido akai-akai, ilimantar da uwaye, da shirye-shiryen tura mara lafiya zuwa babban asibiti.
chw.actions.title: Matakan gaggawa
chw.followup.title: Tsarin sanya ido bayan haihuwa
chw.followup.day1: Rana ta 1: Duba shayarwa, yanayin farkawa, fitsari, da bayan gida.
chw.followup.day2: Rana ta 2–3: Gwada idanu, dasashi, tafukan hannu, da kafa don ganin ko akwai rawaya.
chw.followup.day7: Rana ta 7: Duba yanayin shayarwa, damuwa kan nauyin jiki, da jaundice da ba ta baje ba.
chw.followup.day14: Rana ta 14: Tura jariri zuwa babban asibiti cikin gaggawa idan jaundice ta ki tafiya ko tana karuwa.
chw.referral.title: Tsarin tura mara lafiya asibiti (Referral Pathway)
chw.risk.title: Babban hadarin da ke bukatar kulawar CHW cikin sauri
chw.risk.1: Jaundice ta bayyana a cikin awoyi 24 na farko bayan haihuwa.
chw.risk.2: Rashin shayarwa mai kyau tare da launin rawaya ko yawan barci.
chw.risk.3: Lushin jiki, wuyar farkawa, fitsari mai duhu, ko bayan gida mai fari.
chw.risk.4: Jarirai masu bakar fata tunda launin rawaya na da wuyar fitowa fili da sauri a fatarsu.
chw.alignment.title: Hadin gwiwar kulan jarirai a cikin al'umma
chw.alignment.body: An tsara shi don iyaye da ma'aikatan lafiya na al'umma, wannan tsarin yana tallafawa gano cuta da wuri, sanya ido mataki-mataki, da tura mara lafiya asibiti cikin sauri lokacin da jariri ke bukatar kulawa ta musamman.
reminder.title: Abubuwan da za a sanya ido akai
reminder.text: Abubuwan da aka ba da shawarar sanya ido akai dangane da shekarun jariri a cikin awoyi da matakin hadarin jaundice dinsa.
reminder.empty: Kirkiro bayanin jaririnka don ganin abubuwan sanya ido a nan.
reminder.day1: Rana ta 1: Duba shayarwa, yanayin farkawa, fitsari, da bayan gida.
reminder.day2: Rana ta 2–3: Gwada idanu, dasashi, tafukan hannu, da kafa don ganin ko akwai rawaya.
reminder.day7: Rana ta 7: Duba shayarwa, damuwar nauyin jiki, da jaundice.
reminder.day14: Rana ta 14: Tura jariri zuwa babban asibiti idan jaundice har yanzu tana nan ko tana tsananta.
voice.title: Jagoran Sauti (Voice Guide)
voice.text: Karanta jagorar murya ta atomatik game da jaundice na jarirai ga iyaye.
voice.ready: Jagoran sauti ya riga ya shirya.
voice.unsupported: Na'urarka ba ta da tsarin kunna sauti a gidan yanar gizo.
voice.script: Jaundice ga sabon jiri na iya zama babban abin damuwa idan ba a gano ta da wuri ba. Duba idanun jaririnka, dasashinsa, tafukan hannunsa, da tafukan kafafunsa ko suna da launin rawaya. Kasance mai lura da shayarwarsa, yanayin farkawarsa, fitsari, da bayan gida. Idan jaririnka yana da wuyar farkawa, jikinsa ya yi laushi, ba ya shan nono, ko kuma ya bayyana da launin rawaya a cikin awoyi 24 na farko da haihuwa, tafi da shi asibiti cikin gaggawa a yau.
trust.title: Wannan tsarin gwajin na taimako ne da fadakarwa kawai.
trust.body: Ba ya maye gurbin duba lafiya na likita, ungozoma, ma'aikacin lafiya, ko gwajin jini na bilirubin.
parent.message.urgent: Maza ku kai jaririnku asibiti ba tare da bata lokaci ba. Wannan sakamakon yana bukatar kulawar likita cikin gaggawa a yau.
parent.message.same_day: Jaririnku yana bukatar likita ko ma'aikacin lafiya ya duba shi a yau. Don Allah kada ku bari sai gobe.

amber_uncertain_reason: Wasu alamun suna nuna dan damuwa, amma gwajin hoton bai ba da tabbataccen sakamako ba. Muna ba da shawarar sake gwaji ko tafiya asibiti a yau.
amber_weak_reason: Alamomin sun nuna dan damuwa kuma gwajin hoton bai yi karfi sosai da zai bayar da cikakkiyar gamsuwa ba. Muna ba da shawarar sake gwaji ko tafiya asibiti a yau.
urgent_reason_image: Gwajin hoto ya nuna alamun fargabar cutar jaundice. Muna ba da shawarar a duba shi a asibiti cikin gaggawa a yau.
uncertain_reason: Gwajin hoton bai bayar da tabbataccen sakamako ba. Don Allah sake gwadawa nan ba da dadewa ba sannan ku tafi asibiti idan har yanzu hankalinku bai kwanta ba.
weak_normal_reason: Gwajin hoton bai kai matakin da zai bayar da cikakken tabbacin lafiya ba. Don Allah ku sanya ido kan jariri sosai sannan ku tafi asibiti idan kowane irin alamun cuta suka bayyana.
